name: icon-button
title: Icon button
description: A button that is only an icon but can never be unlabelled: the label is required, shows as a tooltip with its shortcut, and the touch target stays 44px.
docs: label is required: it is the accessible name and the tooltip. shortcut only displays keys in the tooltip; bind the key with Shortcut button or your own handler. The badge can appear and disappear while the button has focus, and its count joins the accessible name. Wrap a toolbar in IconButtonProvider so the tooltips share one delay: after the first, the neighbours open at once. tooltip takes over the tooltip's open state.
